standard_prerequisites.name: Canonical Galois class and equivariant cycle-class formalism
standard_prerequisites.statement: G=Gal(C/R) has order2; omega is its canonical nonzero degree1 class with sign-twisted integral coefficients, pulled back to S. The author uses multiplication by omega3, relative equivariant cohomology, norm exact sequences, high-degree real-locus restriction, purity and the real Lefschetz(1,1) theorem from PartI§1.1-1.6. These remain identified inputs, with all local author computations supplied.

standard_prerequisites.name: Scheiderer divisor/sums-of-squares facts
standard_prerequisites.statement: Author9.19 attributes EPT weakening and the two divisor-removal facts to Scheiderer. Its exact statement and complete author signs argument2960-2982 are supplied, not represented as a newly proved independent PartII question.

standard_prerequisites.name: Conic bundles over arbitrary realclosed fields
standard_prerequisites.statement: Author9.20 explicitly substitutes the general Elman-Lam-Prestel result for Witt, the EPT hypothesis for Broecker, and the signs hypothesis for Stone-Weierstrass; the other reused steps are included. No blanket nonarchimedean extension of900008034 is inferred.

core_obligations: Keep torsion-free cokernel as primary, not unconditional surjectivity or real-IHC when H2(O_X) may be nonzero
Supply both directions, including the full reused conic proof and all9.20 changes
Preserve the Kummer/cup-omega3/real divisor multiplicity core and the exact signs/EPT definitions
Do not add connectedness, existence of real points, Picard2-torsion vanishing or H2(O_S)=0 to the surface primary
proof_roadmap: Obtain sufficiency from the full conic-bundle argument with the exact realclosed-field substitutions.
Compute the product Leray transgression as multiplication by omega3.
Represent collections of real signs by equivariant classes, use torsion-freeness to make a pullback algebraic, and recover rational functions through Kummer theory.
Lift a BH-trivial line bundle through the same exact sequence and use algebraic cycles without real points to obtain even real divisor multiplicities and EPT.
items.difficulty_reason: H3: the result characterizes two geometric sign/divisor properties by an integral cycle-class torsion obstruction. The converse requires a nonroutine multiplicative equivariant Leray calculation, norm/torsion descent, Kummer realization of component signs and odd-degree real-point constraints on divisors. Sufficiency reuses a substantial conic cohomology proof with specific arbitrary-realclosed replacements. All local cores are supplied; short corollaries are not counted separately.
